trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied identifiers (secret name, username, group, role, version, etc.) are treated as a single URL path segment or query value; each Vault class method decides this when it builds Options.url by template concatenation before handing it to the shared axios instance.

landing_point.why: The advisory's two examples are a KV secret name ('../../sys/seal') and a KV version ('1&list=true'); both meet in readKVSecret.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All 49 sites are sibling methods of the one Vault class in src/Vault.js; the only wrappers (updateKVSecretMeta src/Vault.js:3966-3968, updatePkiRole src/Vault.js:2738-2740) delegate to the same methods. No second implementation, transport or lower-level API exists (src/ holds only Vault.js and Config.js).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: genPkiCertificate's JSDoc describes params.role as an enum-like 'internal' or 'exported' type (src/Vault.js:2499), so a solver can treat it as a fixed value rather than an identifier. createPkiRole/updatePkiRole read the name inline as params.name (src/Vault.js:2638), which a search for bare ${name} interpolations does not match.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Several 'identifiers' are legitimately hierarchical: nested KV secret names and folders ('app/db/creds'), KV metadata paths, and the mount/rootPath prefix ('auth/ldap-corp', 'kv-team/'). An over-broad fix that rejects '/' or encodes the mount breaks these. Also the optional version query must stay omitted when falsy.

O6_input_shapes: path segment with '../' traversal (string identifier as positional argument)
identifier destructured from a params object (createADRole, checkADCredOut/In, createToken role_name)
query value with '&'/'=' injection (readKVSecret version, sysMetrics format)
identifier embedded in a prefixed segment ('manage/' + name in checkADCredIn forceMode)

O7_producer.where: URL built inline in each method; no shared URL builder, schema or serializer (src/Vault.js:31-41 only sets baseURL)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: genPkiCertificate interpolates params.role unencoded into the PKI issue path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: JSDoc calls params.role an 'internal'/'exported' type (src/Vault.js:2499), so it reads as a fixed value rather than user input; the advisory does not list role-in-params.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 1100 lines from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: createPkiRole (and wrapper updatePkiRole) interpolates params.name unencoded into the PKI roles path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix encoded the neighbouring readPkiRole/deletePkiRole, so PKI looks done. The name is read inline from params rather than as a ${name} variable, so a grep-driven sweep misses it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 1000 lines from the landing point; reached also via src/Vault.js:2738-2740

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an update wrapper that rebuilds the URL itself, or adds a ?cas=/version query, instead of delegating to the fixed create method
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Other update* methods are thin delegates already; a maintainer adding a check-and-set variant would plausibly inline its own URL.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a versions list sent as a query (?versions=1,2) built by join() instead of in the body
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: versions is an array parameter, so an array-shape query variant is natural and would test the input-shape lesson.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: loginWithCert placing certName in the path (cert/login/<name>) rather than the body
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other login* method (ldap, userpass) puts the identity in the path.

O9_family: path traversal / URL path-segment and query-parameter injection in a client library (CWE-23, CWE-74)

O10_build.toolchain: npm + jest 29 / ts-jest; axios runtime dependency
O10_build.project_tests: The jest suites under tests/*.test.js (e.g. tests/KV.test.js, tests/PKI-roles.test.js) need a live Vault server from container/docker-compose.yaml and tests/process.env (package.json:20-36). Hidden tests can instead stub the axios instance or use a local HTTP listener to check the URL each method sends, offline.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only the KV methods' name (and version) in encodeURIComponent, or sweep '${name}'-style interpolations and miss params.role/params.name inline uses.

out_of_scope_notes: mount/this.rootPath is concatenated raw into every URL (e.g. src/Vault.js:700-707); it is operator configuration and legitimately multi-segment, so it is not treated as an identifier here.
sysInternalCounters calls an undefined reject() on its else branch (src/Vault.js:291), a functional bug.
readPkiCrl drops rootPath in its non-pem branch (src/Vault.js:1904), a functional bug.
unverified: Repository size was not measured. tiny_repo rests on src/ holding only src/Vault.js (~4079 lines) and src/Config.js.
Whether Vault server-side decodes %2F and re-normalises '..' in the encoded path (affects whether encodeURIComponent fully closes traversal and whether nested KV names still work) was not checked.
